description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementUsage class in the OrangeHRM HRM system, representing data related to leave entitlement and usage for employees, including properties like noOfDays, daysUsed, fromDate, toDate, and methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementUsage
classes.description: Data transfer object encapsulating leave entitlement and usage details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize leave entitlement usage data.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the leave entitlement record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the leave entitlement record.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Returns the total number of leave days granted.

methods.name: setNoOfDays
methods.description: Sets the total number of leave days granted.

methods.name: getDaysUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of leave days used.

methods.name: setDaysUsed
methods.description: Sets the number of leave days used.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date of the leave entitlement period.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date of the leave entitlement period.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date of the leave entitlement period.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date of the leave entitlement period.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the length in days of the leave period.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the length in days of the leave period.
